_meta.source: FAOSTAT bulk download service, QCL domain, Jordan.
_meta.warning: NATIONAL AVERAGES. Jordan's vegetable output is dominated by the Jordan Valley, warmer and lower than Mafraq, and these pool open field with protected cultivation. A highland open-field plot should expect less. A starting point to overwrite, not a projection.

eggplant.source: FAOSTAT bulk, Crops and livestock products (QCL), Yield, area Jordan. National average.

sweet_pepper.caveat: FAOSTAT does not separate sweet from hot pepper.
